label: Figure 21.5: Non-inflationary growth
alt: AD/AS diagram: LRAS shifts right from LRAS1 to LRAS2 and AD shifts right from AD1 to AD2 by a matching amount, so output rises from Yf1 to Yf2 with no change in the average price level.
caption: Both LRAS (from LRAS<sub>1</sub> to LRAS<sub>2</sub>) and AD (from AD<sub>1</sub> to AD<sub>2</sub>) shift right by a matching amount, so output rises from Y<sub>f1</sub> to Y<sub>f2</sub> while the average price level, P, stays exactly the same – non-inflationary growth.
